topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I meticulously swept the leaf-covered path, my spade glinting in the sunlight, when my tool sank into something solid. It wasn’t a root—it felt more metallic, almost like a canister. Intrigued, I began to dig around it carefully. After a few minutes, I managed to unearth an old, rusted metal box. I wiped the dirt off, and as the details became clearer, I realized it was some kind of time capsule. The markings were faded, almost illegible, and I couldn’t recall ever burying anything like this. I opened it slowly, the lid creaking protestingly. Inside, I found old photographs, letters, and a dated newspaper, all perfectly preserved. Each item tugged at a mystery within me, connecting to a past I couldn’t quite grasp.
